Ivy: quick bug report — our Node SDK retried a POST on 429 immediately and customer saw duplicate side-effects. Need an SDK + docs decision.

Owen: do we have raw headers? was Retry-After present?

Ivy: server sent Retry-After: 0, no idempotency header attached. Trace: -> POST /create-charge <- 429 Retry-After: 0 -> POST /create-charge <- 201 Created

Nadia: summary proposal for SDK defaults:
- Respect Retry-After if >0.
- Otherwise use exponential backoff + full jitter (base=150ms, factor=2, cap=6s).
- max_retries = 3 for 429/5xx.
- DO NOT auto-retry POST/PUT/PATCH unless Idempotency header present or user enables auto_idempotency.

Owen: pick header name = X-Redwood-Idempotency. SDKs may auto-generate UUIDv4 when auto_idempotency=true. Default false.

Ivy: small DX asks: add a one-line warn if user enables retries for write ops without idempotency; add sample snippets for cURL/Node/Python showing safe patterns.

tools-bot: created examples issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/issues/389 (safe-retries-sample)

Nadia: server pairing checklist: store idempotency results for TTL (24h), return 202+op-id when duplicate arrives while processing, and return stored response if duplicate after completion.

Ivy: ok I'll draft a short changelog blurb and open the Node SDK PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
